text:
Maddie: Heads up — huge triple announcement! Nico just got promoted to Staff Eng 🎉, they and Elie eloped this weekend (omg ❤️), and they brought home a pup named Mochi. Bringing cupcakes tomorrow? :tada:
Nico: omg thank you all!! still processing. we eloped at city hall, it was tiny and perfect. Mochi is a 6mo corgi mix. cupcakes would be amazing :blush:
Sam: CONGRATS NICO!!! Staff engineer!! so well deserved :tada: :partying_face:
Jen: This is the best news. cookies? cupcakes? mochi-shaped macarons? :eyes:
Arjun: Proud of you. ping me when you want me to update the org post for eng. also congrats to Elie! :slightly_smiling_face:
Maddie: @Arjun I'll loop you in. @People Ops Bot can you help with the formal announcement workflow? :pray:
People Ops Bot: Congrats recorded for Nico. Draft announcement template queued for review. Flowers/budget options sent to People Ops. 
Liz: Vote: cupcakes 🍰 (I will bring gluten-free ones) or macarons 🫐? React with :cupcake: or :macaron:
Tara: :cupcake: from me. also when is Mochi coming to the office? :dog:
Nico: Elie said maybe next Friday afternoon if that's cool. Mochi loves snacks. Will bring a pic later.
Sam: MUST have a tiny 'Staff' sash for Mochi. 
Maddie: I'll handle cupcakes + sash. Congrats again, Nico!!! :sparkles:
